Cards are unbound, and might be found in the [[Auction House]] and [[Shard Exchange]]. Cards drop in the [[Illithid Invasion]] content, in Legendary [[Sagas]], and may appear as rewards in later content as well. === [[Illithid Invasion]] === All four types of card appear in each quest, in both the end chests and one optional chest per quest. {| class="wikitable" ! [[Terror of Demogorgon]] || 30 || 60 || 90 || 120 |} === A Festivult Curse! === In 2023's run of [[Festivult]] ([[Update 65]]), the natural drop rate for cards in the four Illithid Invasion quests was doubled, and stacks of cards were added to the reward lists of Legendary [[Saga]]s. During that run of Festivult, stacks of 6 cards were also available as rewards for turning in Gold coins to the [[Jester of Festivult]]. This has since become standard for future runs of Festivult. == About curses == Despite the name, "curses" are generally positive. * Random: You cannot affect which curse you get. (You may be "cursed" with something irrelevant to the character, but rarely detrimental.) * Permanent: They cannot be removed - except using the extremely rare {{Item|Card of Curse Cleansing}}. Also crafting upgrades that effectively destroy the old item and create a brand new one (such as [[Epic Crafting]]) remove the curse. ** Because of this, you can effectively freely reroll Epic items for free using the [[Altar of Epic Rituals]]. Placing an upgradeable Epic item into this machine will recreate the item from scratch, destroying any attached augments---but also removing any Curses. * Curses grant [[Fortune bonus]]. Multiple Fortune bonuses to the same statistic do not stack. * Curses don't affect item binding or minimum level. * Eligible items: named, random, crafted, ... * Ineligible items: Augments, Cosmetics, Wands, Scrolls, Quivers, or Ammunition ** This means that characters can have a maximum of 14 curses equipped at one time (13 if holding a two-handed weapon.) == Curse effects == These are all currently known curses. Has no effect. || - |} == Effects removed during Lamannia preview == * Curse of Stone (weight/sinking), as its effects were largely negative * Curse of Wealth (extra weight and plat value), as it was folded into the Curse of the Sentient's Meal * Curse of Superior Augmentation (Augment Slot), as it could not be safely removed with the {{Item|Card of Curse Cleansing}} * Curse of the Mythical Blessing (Mythic bonus), as it broke the entire stacking system * Curse of the Deckmaster (set bonus), as players pointed out the potential impact on items with relatively malleable set bonuses, and it could not be safely removed with the {{Item|Card of Curse Cleansing}} * Curse of Minor/Major Intuition (lowers item's minimum level); no reason was given, but chances are it could not be safely removed with the {{Item|Card of Curse Cleansing}}, and it might have interfered with the Sentient XP system * the Threat Boost/Reduction elements of all Curses that originally included them (Anger's Heart and Charming Presence), as both could be negative to some characters == External links == * [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1u2Zmw6RWmPgY_fgG6F1ioJzsDgmm6PUs/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113353465401521529988&rtpof=true&sd=true U63 Lamannia Preview 2 Tests]
